trap.label: preposição
trap.wrong: I give in of the pressure, given that she assumes it.
trap.right: I give in to the pressure, given that she presumes it.
trap.why: Give in leva to; given that = visto que; presume baseia-se em indícios.

mcq.q: In “Given that he is late”, given that means…
Presume vs assume vs preclude: preclude means…

fix.wrong: He gave in of the pressure.
fix.right: He gave in to the pressure.

fix.wrong: Given that he is late, he is assumed absent.
fix.right: Given that he is late, he is presumed absent.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “She surrendered to the pressure.” (give in)
rewrite.answer: She gave in to the pressure.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “Since he is late, we leave.” (given that)
rewrite.answer: Given that he is late, we leave.
The claim is precluded by evidence.
